intent.oneSentence: A directed energy pulse arrives at an appearing crystal; the crystal breaks into rigid pieces at the same place and time.
intent.firstRead: A magically prepared crystal breaking when the energy pulse reaches it.

mechanics.driver: The pulse and target remain distinct materials. The pulse arrives at 0.28 + 0.74 = 1.02 s. The crystal starts at 1.02 - 0.36 = 0.66 s and its local center (0,-16) is translated to (64,-16). These numbers are authored, not live event bindings.
mechanics.direction: Energy travels right from (-64,-16) to (64,-16); a crystal prepares at the destination, breaks at 1.02 seconds, then its pieces fall.
mechanics.weightAndMaterial: Retain the existing generator behavior for each material. No new fluid, heat-transfer or collision simulation is introduced.
mechanics.causalChain: A directed energy pulse arrives at an appearing crystal; the crystal breaks into rigid pieces at the same place and time.
mechanics.endingRule: Both sources run to their natural endings; the sequence is empty at 2.17 seconds.
mechanics.exaggerationAndLimits: This is an authored multi-material composition and a reusable data connection, not automatic choreography, artistic certification or Niagara simulation.
